entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 14920 of 2023

Applicant :- Sharad Kumar Verma
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Sectt. Lko

Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Chandra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vivek Chandra, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Shaunak Singh, learned
Aga for the State and perused the records.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicants on bail in Case Crime
No.818 of 2022 under Sections 420, 409 Ipc, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 20.07.2022 against 3 persons, not including the applicant alleging that the informant had made some investment in 'LLC Life Long Multi State Agro Cooperative Society Ltd' but no return was paid on his investment.

entities.text: LLC Life Long Multi State Agro Cooperative Society Ltd
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant has been implicated during investigation as she happened to be a Director of the company.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. The applicant's involvement in 43 other cases of similar nature has been disclosed in para-16 of the affidavit filed in support of the application, in 31 of which the applicant has already been granted bail.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 01.07.2022.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is not named in the FIR; that she has already been granted bail in 31 other cases of similar nature and she is languishing in jail since 01.07.2022 that the five co-accused persons have already been granted bail, without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case,
I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
